Class CurrencypairLookupService

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.instrument.lookup.CurrencypairLookupService
@Service public class CurrencypairLookupService extends Object
Proposes the connectors of a currency pair that is being created. For the history and the intraday feed it tries every activated connector that serves currency pairs of this kind - fiat or cryptocurrency - and reports which of them deliver data, with the URL extension each one needs and, for the history, the oldest closing price.

Most connectors build their request from the two currencies alone (IFeedConnector.FeedIdentifier.CURRENCY) and are probed without an extension. A connector that needs one (IFeedConnector.FeedIdentifier.CURRENCY_URL) derives it through IFeedConnector.deriveCurrencyUrlExtension(CurrencypairLookupData, IFeedConnector.FeedSupport): CoinMarketCap from fixed ids, onvista and Consorsbank from the FactSet notation the onvista search delivers, Boursorama from the symbol its search delivers. A connector that derives nothing - finanzen.ch, finanzen.net and comdirect need a page name that no search delivers - is not offered.

Nothing is written: the probes run on a transient currency pair, and the user copies the chosen connectors into the form, which is saved through the normal dialog and its validation. Every search and every probe runs under a deadline; a failure becomes a status and never discards the results of the others.
